The most significant omission is the failure to describe the motion of the projected light. This movement of light is a primary visual action in the video. Additionally, the caption could be more specific about the background, describing whether the colors fade smoothly into one another or shift abruptly. Finally, the description lacks any mention of how the video concludes, such as the lights fading to black, leaving the women as silhouettes.
